english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when mercy means compassion or a merciful character.
Use this for compassion framed as kindness or mercy, especially in ethical or religious contexts.

examples.english: They have a lot of mercy in their hearts and always help neighbours in need.
The master taught us to have compassion for all living beings.
examples.traditional: 師父教我哋對眾生要有慈悲心。
